description: This file defines the StimulationInputs class which creates a GUI panel for configuring stimulation parameters such as RPM range, engine load, coolant temperature, intake air temperature, throttle position, and EL resistance, for an ECU stimulator within the project.

classes.name: StimulationInputs
classes.description: A class providing a UI panel to input various stimulation parameters for a piston engine ECU stimulator.

methods.name: StimulationInputs
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GUI components for stimulation input parameters.

methods.name: getEngineLoadMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum engine load value from the UI control.

methods.name: getEngineLoadMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum engine load value from the UI control.

methods.name: getRpmFrom
methods.description: Returns the starting RPM value as an integer.

methods.name: getRpmTo
methods.description: Returns the ending RPM value as an integer.

methods.name: getCltFrom
methods.description: Returns the coolant temperature's lower bound.

methods.name: getCltTo
methods.description: Returns the coolant temperature's upper bound.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing all input controls.

methods.name: getEngineLoadR2Resistance
methods.description: Returns the EL resistance value set in the UI.

methods.name: getEngineLoadStep
methods.description: Returns the step value for engine load.
